name: Singapore Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun®
short_description: A half marathon held on 11 October 2026 at Marina Barrage, Singapore, with 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distance options.
ai_summary: The Singapore Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® takes place on 11 October 2026 at Marina Barrage, Singapore. Organized by JomRun Pte Ltd, the event offers three distance options: 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half marathon as the primary race. Registration is currently open at a price of SGD 88.88.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km) suit different fitness levels
Scenic Marina Barrage venue in Singapore
research_highlights: This is a JomRun-organised event distinct from the BYD Singapore International Marathon; the Singapore Half Marathon listing itself states it 'is organised by JomRun Pte Ltd and is not affiliated with the BYD Singapore International Marathon 2026 organised by SG international Marathon Pte. Ltd.'
Categories on offer are 5KM and 10KM fun runs plus a 21.1KM competitive run, with only the 21.1KM category receiving a timing chip (TrackAsia RFID) while the 5KM and 10KM bibs are untimed.

As of the most recent search, the official JomRun event page still lists date, time and venue as 'To Be Confirmed', and a running calendar site notes the race 'is a different organiser at a different venue and is still ahead on the calendar' for 11 October 2026.
research_watchouts: No participant race reports, reviews, or community discussion specific to this event were found — it appears to be a new/upcoming edition without a public track record yet, so course conditions, crowd support, and organisational quality could not be verified from first-hand accounts.
Official date, time and venue details were still marked 'To Be Confirmed' at the time of this research, so logistics could change before race day.

faqs.question: When is the Singapore Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® taking place?
faqs.answer: The Singapore Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is scheduled to take place on 11 October 2026. The event is organized by JomRun Pte Ltd and will be held at the Marina Barrage venue in Singapore, with registration currently open for interested participants ahead of race day.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at this event: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half marathon distance is the primary race offered, giving runners of varying experience and fitness levels the flexibility to select the distance that best suits their goals.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Singapore Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is priced at SGD 88.88. This is the stated price range for the event, and registration is currently open, allowing runners to sign up for the 5km, 10km, or 21.1km distance options.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at Marina Barrage, a venue located in Singapore. This location serves as the setting for all distance categories offered at the event, including the 5km, 10km, and the primary 21.1km half marathon distance, on the scheduled race date of 11 October 2026.
